## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    N_{t+1} = b N_t - d N_t
$${#eq-birth-death-discrete}

$$
    \frac{dN}{dt} = (b - d) N
$${#eq-birth-death-continuous}


$$
    \frac{dN}{dt} = r N (1 - \frac{N}{K})
$${#eq-logistic-growth}

$$
    N_{t+1} = N_t e^{r (1 - \frac{N_t}{K})}
$${#eq-ricker}

$$
    N_{t+1} = N_t^b K^{1 -b}
$${#eq-gompertz}

$$
    \frac{dp}{dt} = c p (1 - p) - e p
$${#eq-levins-metapop}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d n_1}{dt} = r_1 n_1(1 - \frac{\alpha_{11} n_1 + \alpha_{12} n_2 }{K_1}) \\
    \frac{d n_2}{dt} = r_2 n_2(1 - \frac{\alpha_{22} n_2 + \alpha_{21} n_1 }{K_2})
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-lotka-voltera}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d p_1}{dt} & = c_1 p_1 (1 - p_1) - e_1 p_1\\
    \frac{d p_2}{dt} & = c_2 p_2 (1 - (p_1 + p_2)) - e_1 p_2 - c_1 p_1 p_2
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-cc-tradeoff}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d N}{dt} & = r N (1 - \frac{N}{K}) - \frac{a N P}{\kappa + P} \\
    \frac{d P}{dt} & =  \frac{ \beta a N P}{k + P} - d P
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-rosenzweig-macarthur}
